_README: This file is HAND-EDITED ONLY. No script writes to it.
Each ratio enforces a structural property of PowDB that should not silently degrade.
Raising a ceiling means the thesis gave ground — justify it in the commit message.

powql_point_over_btree_lookup.meaning: Full PowQL parser+planner+executor overhead over the raw B-tree probe. Previous ceilings: 2.5 (M1, btree_lookup ~1832ns), 6.0 (Mission D, btree_lookup ~262ns, observed 5.004x). PR #14 CI: 1529ns / 248ns = 6.172x — btree_lookup improved -6.15% while powql_point was -1.59%, both within absolute gates. Same denominator-shrinkage pattern. Relaxed 6.0 -> 7.0 with ~13% headroom. The absolute gate on powql_point (7%) is the real regression detector; this ratio guards against structural parse/plan/exec overhead growth.

scan_filter_count_over_btree_lookup.meaning: Sanity ceiling: a count-filter aggregate over 100K rows vs a single B-tree probe. Previous ceiling was 2500 after Mission D10 (545729ns / 262ns = 2079.734x). v0.5.0 release-gate rebaseline observed 587121ns / 202.6ns = 2898.280x: the aggregate absolute gate remained baseline-equivalent while btree_lookup improved materially, shrinking the denominator. Relaxed 2500 -> 3500 with ~20% headroom for the same denominator-shrinkage pattern documented on powql_point_over_btree_lookup. The absolute gate on powql_aggregation remains the real regression detector; this ratio still catches structural loss of the compiled predicate/raw-bytes aggregate path.

update_by_pk_over_powql_point.meaning: An indexed update should be within a small multiple of an indexed read. Previous ceiling was 15000 (pre-FASTPATH, when update_by_pk was an O(N) full-rescan). Mission C Phase 14 (update_pk prepared fast path) landed the Update(IndexScan) fold and collapsed the ratio from ~9130x to 1.218x (1596ns / 1311ns). Tightened 15000 -> 2.0 to lock in the structural win — any future regression that loses the Update(IndexScan) fold will blow past this instantly.

insert_single_over_btree_lookup.meaning: Insert hot path vs a B-tree probe. Previous ceilings: 10.0, 12.0, 14.0, 16.0 (all pre-hardening). Post-hardening (LSN-tagged pages, CRC32 catalog, WAL infrastructure, bounds checks, StorageError enum) the insert path accumulated significant per-call overhead. CI observed 77659ns / 291ns = 266.3x. The absolute gate on insert_single (10%) is the real regression detector; this ratio catches structural regressions. Issue filed to investigate and optimize the insert_single hot path.
